themes.title: Photo capture on mobile fails or is abandoned
themes.statement: 3 of 6 participants said photo capture or upload on mobile failed or was abandoned; 1 said capture worked.

quotes.text: the app loses the photo half the time
I gave up on the mobile app and just email myself the receipts
the photo upload fails more than it works

contradictions.text: Receipt capture worked fine for me

themes.title: Approvals take a long time with little visible progress
themes.statement: 6 of 6 participants described waiting on approvals with no clear sign of progress.

quotes.text: Approvals sit with my manager for a week ... nobody tells me.
My manager approves things in batches on Fridays, so I wait.
I do not know who has my report right now. It just says pending.
Pending for days feels like nobody is looking at it.
I waited ten days for a four hundred dollar reimbursement.
I check the status page every morning

themes.title: Export matches the accounting format but is hard to find
themes.statement: 3 of 6 participants commented on export: two valued it, one could not find the button.

quotes.text: The export to our accounting system is the only part I trust.
exports come out in the format my accountant wants
The export button is hidden under three menus.
